title.narrative: 23M-UBU - Micro Water Management Toolkit for Sustainable Water Resource Areas in Climate Vulnerable Coastal Regions (India)

description.narrative: The long term objective is sustainable use and management of groundwater resources. Intermediate objectives are 1) the DRYP IoT based toolkit effectively show the groundwater situation in Basanti on mobile devices anywhere and anytime, 2) local water managers operate the tool and use it in decision making, and 3) that the citizens of Basanti also have overview of their water resource and can use it in the advocacy for a better water supply. Transparency for all (via mobile apps) in water resource availability shall allow for higher level of inclusiveness and social fairness. Coping with climate change and overexploitation of groundwater is the overarching basis for the project design, and engagement of local resources and creation of local jobs for youth and women (for operating and maintaining the water monitoring technologies) to create more ownership is fundamental in the solution.
